summary:
AgriEye AI is an AI-powered smart agriculture assistant designed to help farmers make better decisions and protect their crops. The project combines artificial intelligence with agricultural information to support plant health analysis, soil assessment, and smarter farming practices.

Users can interact with an intelligent assistant, submit plant images for analysis, and receive information and recommendations to help identify potential agricultural problems. The project aims to make agricultural knowledge more accessible, improve early awareness of crop stress, and encourage sustainable farming.

AgriEye AI explores how NASA Earth science resources and modern AI technologies can support agriculture by connecting environmental data with practical agricultural insights.

Our mission is to make farming smarter, more accessible, and more sustainable.
details: Artificial intelligence tools were used to assist with code development, content preparation, and AI-powered agricultural interactions. Google Gemini is integrated as the project's AI assistant. AI-assisted elements are identified transparently, and all generated visual content is labeled where applicable.
